title: Long-time existence and behavior of the Calabi flow
exact_target:
What is the behavior of $g_{j \overline k}(t)$ solving the Calabi flow,
\[\frac \partial {\partial t} g_{j \overline k} = \partial_j \partial_{\overline k} R?\]
Can long time existence be established for toric surfaces?
